title: Smaller than average loaf pans
text: Smaller than average loaf pans. Quality is ok, easy to clean and work well. The size is a little smaller than standard loaf pans which can mess up recipe quantities. The silicone deforms a bit when filled up, so the middle of the loaf is wider than the ends. Also the pan has to be placed on a metal tray to put into the oven easily as it is flexible. Ok for the price.
